name: Peptidoglycan Biosynthesis and Cell Wall Assembly
description: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis in Escherichia coli is the essential process of bacterial cell wall synthesis, involving cytoplasmic synthesis of UDP-NAM-pentapeptide precursors, membrane-localized lipid II assembly, and periplasmic transglycosylation and transpeptidation by penicillin-binding proteins (PBPs). This pathway is the primary target of β-lactam antibiotics and is essential for cell shape determination, osmotic protection, and cell division.
